verdict.rationale: Khoj ships as a self-hostable server you can install via Docker or pip and configure through environment variables, which implies it can run without a desktop UI. It also offers built-in scheduled automations that run queries and email the results. However, nothing in the evidence documents a headless CLI, an API usable from CI, or scripted invocation, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. One community report also notes a Docker build failure. Missing for 10: documented headless/CLI mode, documented programmatic API for CI pipelines, CI integration examples, hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
